'success' : 'error');%0A  });%0A  overlay.querySelector('%23bl-open').addEventListener('click', () => {%0A    if (!built) return;%0A    log('Opening the link just built (same tab) to check it');%0A    overlay.remove();%0A    window.open(built.url, '_blank', 'noopener');   // hashchange loads it%0A  });%0A  overlay.querySelector('%23bl-close').addEventListener('click', () => { log('Share-link builder closed'); overlay.remove(); });%0A  overlay.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') overlay.remove(); });%0A  ta.focus();%0A  refresh();%0A}%0A%0A/* ------------------------------ Paste a list ----------------------------- */%0A/* Copying a table out of a portal, a mail client or a spreadsheet and pasting it%0A   straight into Turnstone is the shortest path there is — no file, no download,%0A   no export button to hunt for. The clipboard carries both `text/html` (the real%0A   markup, multi-line cells and all) and `text/plain` (tab-separated), and the%0A   first is strictly better when it holds a table, so it wins.%0A%0A   Nothing is loaded without confirmation: a paste that turns out to be a sentence%0A   must never silently replace the list you are working through. */%0Aconst PASTE_MIN_ROWS = 2;%0Afunction isEditableTarget(t) {%0A  if (!t || !t.tagName) return false;%0A  const tag = t.tagName.toLowerCase();%0A  return tag === 'input' || tag === 'textarea' || tag === 'select' || t.isContentEditable === true;%0A}%0A%0A/** The best list the clipboard is offering, or null. */%0Afunction clipboardListText(dt) {%0A  const html = dt.getData('text/html') || '';%0A  if (/<table[\s>]/i.test(html)) return { text: html, kind: 'html', why: 'an HTML table on the clipboard' };%0A  const text = dt.getData('text/plain') || '';%0A  if (!text.trim()) return null;%0A  if (/<table[\s>]/i.test(text)) return { text, kind: 'html', why: 'a table pasted as markup' };%0A  return { text, kind: 'text', why: 'plain text on the clipboard' };%0A}%0A%0A/** Parse pasted text into a matrix, or throw. `force` names the format explicitly,%0A    which the workspace-link path needs: a link has no filename for the extension%0A    hint to read, so `&format=md` is how a caller says what it is holding. */%0Aasync function pasteToMatrix(clip, force = '') {%0A  if (force) {%0A    const buf = new TextEncoder().encode(clip.text).buffer;%0A    const det = detectFormat(buf, `inline.${force}`, '');%0A    const { rows } = await parseDetected(buf, det, null, { allowLinkFallback: true });%0A    return { rows, format: det.format };%0A  }%0A  if (clip.kind === 'html') {%0A    const buf = new TextEncoder().encode(clip.text).buffer;%0A    const det = detectFormat(buf, '', 'text/html');%0A    const { rows } = await parseDetected(buf, det, null, { allowLinkFallback: true });%0A    return { rows, format: det.format };%0A  }%0A  const head = clip.text.slice(0, 4096);%0A  const sniffed = sniffTextFormat(head);%0A  const format = sniffed === 'md' ? 'md' : sniffed === 'json' ? 'json' : /\t/.test(clip.text) ? 'tsv' : 'csv';%0A  const rows = format === 'md' ? parseMarkdownText(clip.text)%0A    : format === 'json' ? parseJsonText(clip.text)%0A    : parseDelimitedText(clip.text, format);%0A  return { rows, format };%0A}%0A%0A/** Build the confirmation dialog: what was understood, shown as a table. */%0Afunction showPastePreview(rows, format, why) {%0A  const width = rows.reduce((m, r) => Math.max(m, r.length), 0);%0A  const body = rows.filter(r => r.some(c => String(c ?? '').trim())).length;%0A  const head = rows.slice(0, 6);%0A  log(`Paste candidate: ${why} → ${formatLabel(format)}, ${body} row(s) × ${width} col(s)`);%0A  const overlay = document.createElement('div');%0A  overlay.id = 'paste-modal';%0A  const cell = (v) => `<td title="${esc(v)}">${esc(v)}</td>`;%0A  overlay.innerHTML = `%0A    <div class="modal-box">%0A      <h3 class="modal-title">Load this pasted list?</h3>%0A      <p class="modal-sub">Read as <b>${formatLabel(format)}</b> — ${body} row${body === 1 ? '' : 's'} × ${width} column${width === 1 ? '' : 's'}.</p>%0A      <div class="paste-preview"><table>%0A        <tbody>${head.map(r => `<tr>${r.map(c => cell(String(c ?? ''))).join('')}</tr>`).join('')}</tbody>%0A      </table></div>%0A      <div class="srow">%0A        <button class="btn primary" id="paste-load">Load ${body} row${body === 1 ? '' : 's'}</button>%0A        <button class="modal-cancel" id="paste-cancel">Not this</button>%0A      </div>%0A    </div>`;%0A  mountPoint().appendChild(overlay);%0A  overlay.querySelector('%23paste-load').onclick = () => {%0A    overlay.remove();%0A    loadMatrix(rows, { name: 'Pasted list', ext: format, mode: 'fallback' });%0A    scheduleSave(0);%0A  };%0A  overlay.querySelector('%23paste-cancel').onclick = () => { log('Paste discarded'); overlay.remove(); };%0A  overlay.querySelector('%23paste-load').focus();%0A}%0A%0A/** Handle a paste anywhere in the app that is not a text field. */%0Aasync function onPaste(e) {%0A  if (isEditableTarget(e.target)) return;                      // typing, not loading%0A  if (modalOpen('%23mode-picker, %23portal-modal, %23paste-modal, %23sheet-picker, %23menu')) return;%0A  const dt = e.clipboardData;%0A  if (!dt) return;%0A  const files = [...(dt.files || [])];%0A  if (files.length) { e.preventDefault(); log(`Paste carried ${files.length} file(s)`); await handleDroppedFiles(dt); return; }%0A  const clip = clipboardListText(dt);%0A  if (!clip) return;%0A  let parsed;%0A  try { parsed = await pasteToMatrix(clip); }%0A  catch (err2) {%0A    /* An image or a screenshot lands here: there is no OCR in this build, and a%0A       silently ignored paste would look like a bug. Say so plainly instead. */%0A    log('Paste could not be read as a list:', err2.message);%0A    toast(`That paste is not a list — ${err2.message}`, 'error');%0A    return;%0A  }%0A  const body = parsed.rows.filter(r => r.some(c => String(c ?? '').trim())).length;%0A  /* `plausibleTable`, not `plausibleList`: a paragraph split on its commas is%0A     shaped like a table to a lenient test, and it must not be allowed to replace%0A     the list the user is working through. */%0A  if (body < PASTE_MIN_ROWS || !plausibleTable(parsed.rows)) {%0A    if (clip.text.trim().split(/\r?\n/).filter(l => l.trim()).length >= 3) {%0A      log(`Paste had ${body} row(s) and is not list-shaped — ignored`);%0A      toast('That paste does not look like a list — copy a table from a spreadsheet or portal first', 'error');%0A    }%0A    return;%0A  }%0A  e.preventDefault();%0A  showPastePreview(parsed.rows, parsed.format, clip.why);%0A}%0A%0A/** Menu action: read the clipboard directly when the browser allows it. */%0Aasync function pasteFromClipboard() {%0A  if (!navigator.clipboard || !navigator.clipboard.read) {%0A    log('Clipboard read API unavailable — asking the user to paste instead');%0A    toast('Press Ctrl+V (⌘V on a Mac) anywhere in Turnstone to paste your list', 'success');%0A    return;%0A  }%0A  try {%0A    const items = await navigator.clipboard.read();%0A    for (const item of items) {%0A      const htmlType = item.types.find(t => t === 'text/html');%0A      const textType = item.types.find(t => t === 'text/plain');%0A      const blob = await item.getType(htmlType || textType);%0A      const text = await blob.text();%0A      const clip = { text, kind: htmlType ? 'html' : 'text' };%0A      const parsed = await pasteToMatrix(clip);%0A      if (plausibleTable(parsed.rows)) { showPastePreview(parsed.rows, parsed.format, 'the clipboard'); return; }%0A    }%0A    toast('Nothing list-shaped on the clipboard', 'error');%0A  } catch (e) {%0A    warn('Clipboard read was refused', e);%0A    toast('Press Ctrl+V (⌘V on a Mac) anywhere in Turnstone to paste your list', 'success');%0A  }%0A}%0A%0A/** Read a File/Blob (picked locally) and load it. */%0Aasync function loadFromFileObject(file, handle) {%0A  state.sourceUrl = null; // local picks are not shareable via ?file=%0A  log(`Reading picked file "${file.name}" (${file.size} bytes, type="${file.type || 'unknown'}", fsHandle=${!!handle})`);%0A  try {%0A    const buf = await file.arrayBuffer();%0A    const det = detectFormat(buf, file.name, file.type);%0A    const { rows: matrix, sheetName } = await parseDetected(buf, det, null, { allowLinkFallback: true });%0A    if (!matrix.length) { toast('File appears to be empty', 'error'); warn('Empty file:', file.name); return; }%0A    // Only formats we can rebuild get silent write-back; the rest import one-way.%0A    const writable = canWrite(det.format);%0A    if (!writable) {%0A      log(`"${det.format}" is import-only — write-back disabled, edits persist to ${storageLabel()}`);%0A      toast(`${formatLabel(det.format)} imports as a one-way conversion — your edits save to ${storageLabel()}. Use Export to keep them.`, 'success');%0A    }%0A    const keep = writable && !!handle;%0A    loadMatrix(matrix, { name: file.name, ext: det.format, mode: keep ? 'fs' : 'fallback', handle: keep ? handle : null, sheetName });%0A    await rememberFile(keep ? { key: 'active', kind: 'fs', name: file.name, ts: Date.now(), handle }%0A                            : { key: 'active', kind: 'fallback', name: file.name, ts: Date.now(), handle: null });%0A    scheduleSave(0); // persist a session snapshot right away (fallback modes)%0A  } catch (e) {%0A    err('Failed to load file', file.name, e);%0A    toast(`Could not parse "${file.name}": ${e.message}`, 'error');%0A  }%0A}%0A%0A/* ---------------------- Drag & drop initial acquisition ------------------- */%0A/** True when a drag is carrying files from the OS (not an in-page drag like the%0A    settings panel's column reordering, which must stay untouched). */%0Afunction isFileDrag(e) {%0A  return [...((e.dataTransfer && e.dataTransfer.types) || [])].includes('Files');%0A}%0A%0A/** Chromium hands dropped files a real handle, which can restore silent write-back.%0A    Resolve it only when it is already writable — no surprise permission dialog on drop. */%0Aasync function handleFromDrop(dt) {%0A  const item = [...(dt.items || [])].find(i => i.kind === 'file' && typeof i.getAsFileSystemHandle === 'function');%0A  if (!item) return null;%0A  try {%0A    const handle = await item.getAsFileSystemHandle();%0A    if (!handle || handle.kind !== 'file') return null;%0A    if (!handle.queryPermission) return handle;%0A    const state = await handle.queryPermission({ mode: 'readwrite' });%0A    if (state === 'granted') { log(`Dropped file "${handle.name}" is writable → silent write-back enabled`); return handle; }%0A    log('Dropped file handle is read-only — edits will go to browser storage (use the drop zone→picker, or Open file…, for live write-back)');%0A    return null;%0A  } catch (e) {%0A    warn('Could not read a file handle from the drop', e);%0A    return null;%0A  }%0A}%0A%0A/** Load the file(s) of a drop. Extra files are reported rather than silently ignored. */%0Aasync function handleDroppedFiles(dt) {%0A  const files = [...(dt.files || [])];%0A  if (!files.length) return;%0A  if (files.length > 1) warn(`Drop carried ${files.length} files — loading the first one ("${files[0].name}")`);%0A  const file = files[0];%0A  log(`Dropped file "${file.name}" (${file.size} bytes, type="${file.type || 'unknown'}")`);%0A  toast(`Reading ${file.name}…`);%0A  await loadFromFileObject(file, await handleFromDrop(dt));%0A}%0A%0A/** If this exact file was previously worked on in fallback mode, reuse its statuses/notes. */%0Aasync function readSessionMetaFor(name) {%0A  try {%0A    const sess = await idbGet('session', 'session');%0A    if (sess && sess.name === name) { log('Found prior fallback session for', name); return sess; }%0A  } catch (e) { warn('No session meta', e); }%0A  return null;%0A}%0A%0A/* --------------------------- File acquisition ---------------------------- */%0Aconst FS_PICK_OPTS = {%0A  types: [{%0A    description: 'Link list (CSV, TSV, XLSX, XLS, ODS, DOCX, EML, JSON, HTML, XML)',%0A    accept: {%0A      'text/csv': ['.csv', '.tsv', '.tab', '.txt'],%0A      'text/plain': ['.csv', '.tsv', '.txt'],%0A      'application/json': ['.json', '.jsonl', '.ndjson'],%0A      'text/html': ['.html', '.htm'],%0A      'message/rfc822': ['.eml', '.mht', '.mhtml'],%0A      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document': ['.docx'],%0A      'application/xml': ['.xml', '.rss', '.atom', '.opml'],%0A      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet': ['.xlsx', '.xlsm'],%0A      'application/vnd.ms-excel': ['.xls', '.xlsb'],%0A      'application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.spreadsheet': ['.ods'],%0A    },%0A  }],%0A  excludeAcceptAllOption: false,%0A  multiple: false,%0A};%0A%0Aasync function openLocalFile() {%0A  log(`Open file requested. showOpenFilePicker available: ${!!window.showOpenFilePicker}`);%0A  if (window.showOpenFilePicker) {%0A    try {%0A      const [handle] = await window.showOpenFilePicker(FS_PICK_OPTS);%0A      log('File handle acquired:', handle.name);%0A      const file = await handle.getFile();%0A      await loadFromFileObject(file, handle);%0A    } catch (e) {%0A      if (e.name === 'AbortError') { log('File picker aborted by user'); return; }%0A      err('showOpenFilePicker failed, using fallback input', e);%0A      els.fileInput.click();%0A    }%0A  } else {%0A    log('File System Access API unavailable → <input type=file> fallback');%0A    els.fileInput.click();%0A  }%0A}%0A%0A/** Open a workspace link — a list carried in the URL itself, with nothing to fetch.%0A *%0A * This is the path an agent's link takes: it reads the payload, hands the text to%0A * the same parser a paste goes through, and loads the matrix. The bar for accepting%0A * it is deliberately the *file* bar rather than the paste bar — a link is an explicit%0A * hand-off, so it is opened rather than questioned, and the load toast reports what%0A * was read. Only a payload with no list in it at all is refused.%0A */%0Aasync function loadInlineWorkspace(raw) {%0A  const dec = await decodeInlineList(raw);%0A  loadedInlineKey = String(raw.zdata || raw.data || '');%0A  log(`Workspace link: ${dec.encoding}, ${dec.bytes} bytes of list decoded`);%0A  if (dec.bytes > INLINE_WARN_BYTES) warn(`Workspace link carries ${Math.round(dec.bytes / 1024)} KB — a truncated share is the usual way this fails`);%0A  const { rows, format } = await pasteToMatrix(%0A    { text: dec.text, kind: 'text', why: 'a workspace link' },%0A    String(raw.format || '').trim().toLowerCase(),%0A  );%0A  const filled = rows.filter(r => r.some(c => String(c ?? '').trim()));%0A  if (filled.length < 2) {%0A    throw new Error('it decoded, but there was no list in it — a link cut short in transit looks like this');%0A  }%0A  const name = String(raw.name || '').trim();%0A  loadMatrix(rows, { name: name || 'Shared workspace', ext: format, mode: 'fallback' });%0A  /* cardCount(), not the row count: `filled` includes the header row, and reporting%0A     "11 rows" for a ten-task workspace is exactly the kind of off-by-one that makes%0A     a person distrust the number. */%0A  toast(`Opened a shared workspace — ${cardCount()} task${cardCount() === 1 ? '' : 's'} read from the link`, 'success');%0A  scheduleSave(0);%0A}%0A%0A/** One entry point for "somebody handed me a string": open the list inside a%0A    workspace link, or fetch the file the URL points at. The routing rule is%0A    `workspaceLinkFrom` (pure, tested in Node); this is only the dispatch, so the%0A    welcome panel's field, the ☰ menu item and the deep-link paths all behave the%0A    same way. Throws whatever the loader throws — callers own the message. */%0Aasync function openPastedSource(raw) {%0A  const look = workspaceLinkFrom(raw);%0A  if (look.ok) {%0A    log(`Pasted a workspace link (the list is in ${look.where}) → opening it rather than fetching anything`);%0A    await loadInlineWorkspace(look.params);%0A    return 'link';%0A  }%0A  log(`Not a workspace link (${look.why}) → treating it as a file URL`);%0A  await loadFromUrl(raw);%0A  return 'file';%0A}%0A%0A/** Load a remote file from ?file=/?url= param or the welcome-panel input. */%0A%0Aasync function loadFromUrl(fileUrl) {%0A  fileUrl = String(fileUrl || '').trim();%0A  let parsed;%0A  try {%0A    parsed = new URL(fileUrl, location.href);%0A  } catch (e) {%0A    toast('That does not look like a valid URL', 'error');%0A    warn('URL parse failed for', fileUrl, e);%0A    return;%0A  }%0A  if (!/^https?:$/.test(parsed.protocol)) { toast('Only http(s) URLs can be fetched', 'error'); return; }%0A  // Bare words resolve as relative URLs — require a scheme or at least a dot before wasting a fetch.%0A  if (!/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.\-]*:/i.test(fileUrl) && !fileUrl.includes('.')) {%0A    toast('That does not look like a valid URL', 'error');%0A    warn('Rejected non-URL input:', fileUrl);%0A    return;%0A  }%0A  if (parsed.href === location.href) { toast('That URL is this app itself — paste a data file URL', 'error'); return; }%0A%0A  log(`Loading remote file: ${fileUrl}`);%0A  toast(`Fetching ${parsed.pathname.split('/').pop() || parsed.host}…`);%0A  els.btnLoadUrl.disabled = true;%0A  try {%0A    const res = await fetch(fileUrl, { redirect: 'follow' });%0A    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status} ${res.statusText}`);%0A    const buf = await res.arrayBuffer();%0A    log(`Fetched ${buf.byteLength} bytes (content-type: ${res.headers.get('content-type') || 'unknown'})`);%0A%0A    // Format detection: magic bytes first, then content sniffing, then URL extension and Content-Type.%0A    const det = detectFormat(buf, parsed.pathname, res.headers.get('content-type'));%0A%0A    // Guard: many hosts serve an HTML error/landing page with HTTP 200. Remote HTML is%0A    // only believed when it really carries a table — never its navigation link list.%0A    if (det.format === 'html' && det.ext !== 'html' && det.ext !== 'htm') {%0A      throw new Error(det.ext%0A        ? `that URL returned a web page, not a ${det.ext.toUpperCase()} file`%0A        : 'that URL returned a web page — paste a direct link to a data file instead');%0A    }%0A%0A    let { rows: matrix, sheetName } = await parseDetected(buf, det, null, { allowLinkFallback: false });%0A    if (isWorkbookFormat(det.format) && await wbHasMultipleSheets(buf)) {%0A      const pick = await pickSheetName(buf, sheetName);%0A      if (pick === null) { log('User cancelled sheet picker — load aborted'); return; }%0A      ({ rows: matrix, sheetName } = await parseDetected(buf, det, pick));%0A    }%0A    if (!matrix.length) { toast('Remote file appears to be empty', 'error'); return; }%0A%0A    // If this URL was worked on before in fallback mode, restore its statuses/notes (round-trip for remote files).%0A    const meta = await readSessionMetaFor(fileUrl);%0A    loadMatrix(matrix, { name: parsed.pathname.split('/').pop() || parsed.host, ext: det.format, mode: 'remote', sheetName, sourceUrl: fileUrl, status: meta?.status, notes: meta?.notes });%0A    await rememberFile({ key: 'active', kind: 'url', name: state.name, ts: Date.now(), handle: null, url: fileUrl });%0A    scheduleSave(0);%0A  } catch (e) {%0A    err('Remote file load failed', e);%0A    // Only network problems get the fetch/CORS framing; parse and format errors%0A    // (unsupported format, HTML error page, malformed XML) speak for themselves.%0A    if (/Failed to fetch|NetworkError|load failed/i.test(String(e.message))) {%0A      toast(`Fetch failed: ${e.message}. The host may block cross-origin reads (CORS) — or the URL is unreachable.`, 'error');%0A    } else {%0A      toast(String(e.message), 'error');%0A    }%0A  } finally {%0A    els.btnLoadUrl.disabled = false;%0A  }%0A}%0A%0A/** Sheet-name list for the workbook behind `buf` (SheetJS returns an array OR {SheetNames}). */%0Aasync function sheetNamesOf(buf) {%0A  if (!HAS_XLSX) return [];%0A  const info = await XLSX.read(buf, { type: 'array', bookSheets: true });%0A  return Array.isArray(info) ? info : (info && info.SheetNames) || [];%0A}%0A%0A/** True when the workbook behind `buf` has more than one sheet. */%0Aasync function wbHasMultipleSheets(buf) {%0A  try { return (await sheetNamesOf(buf)).length > 1; }%0A  catch (e) { warn('Could not inspect sheet list', e); return false; }%0A}%0A%0A/** Ask the user which worksheet to load (only for multi-sheet workbooks). Returns null when cancelled. */%0Afunction pickSheetName(buf, current) {%0A  return new Promise(async (resolve) => {%0A    const names = await sheetNamesOf(buf);%0A    log(`Multi-sheet workbook detected: [${names.join(', ')}]`);%0A    const overlay = document.createElement('div');%0A    overlay.id = 'sheet-picker';%0A    overlay.innerHTML = `%0A      <div class="modal-box wide-options">%0A        <h3 class="modal-title">Multiple sheets found</h3>%0A        <p class="modal-sub">Which worksheet holds your task list?</p>%0A        ${names.map(n => `<button data-sheet="${esc(n)}" class="sheet-opt${n === current ? ' current' : ''}">${esc(n)}</button>`).join('')}%0A        <button id="sheet-cancel" class="modal-cancel">Cancel</button>%0A      </div>`;%0A    mountPoint().appendChild(overlay);%0A    overlay.querySelector('%23sheet-cancel').onclick = () => { overlay.remove(); resolve(null); };%0A    overlay.querySelectorAll('button[data-sheet]').forEach(b => { b.onclick = () => { const s = b.dataset.sheet; overlay.remove(); log('User picked sheet:', s); resolve(s); }; });%0A  });%0A}%0A%0A/* --------------------- Restore / recent files (IDB) ---------------------- */%0Aasync function rememberFile(activeRecord) {%0A  try {%0A    await idbPut('handles', activeRecord);%0A    await idbPut('handles', { key: activeRecord.name, kind: activeRecord.kind, name: activeRecord.name, ts: activeRecord.ts, handle: activeRecord.handle });%0A    els.miRestore.hidden = false;%0A    log('File handle remembered in IndexedDB (active + recents)');%0A  } catch (e) { warn('Could not persist file handle', e); }%0A}%0A%0Aasync function restoreLastFile() {%0A  log('Restore Workspace clicked');%0A  try {%0A    const rec = await idbGet('handles', 'active');%0A    if (!rec) { toast('No previous workspace found', 'error'); return; }%0A    if (rec.kind === 'fs' && rec.handle) {%0A      let perm = await rec.handle.queryPermission({ mode: 'readwrite' });%0A      log(`Saved handle permission: ${perm}`);%0A      if (perm !== 'granted') {%0A        perm = await rec.handle.requestPermission({ mode: 'readwrite' });%0A        log(`Requested handle permission: ${perm}`);%0A      }%0A      if (perm !== 'granted') { toast('Permission denied — pick the file again', 'error'); return; }%0A      const file = await rec.handle.getFile();%0A      await loadFromFileObject(file, rec.handle);%0A    } else {%0A      const sess = await idbGet('session', 'session');%0A      if (!sess || !sess.data) { toast('No saved browser session found', 'error'); return; }%0A      log('Restoring fallback session from IndexedDB:', sess.name);%0A      loadMatrix(sess.data, { name: sess.name, ext: sess.ext || 'csv', mode: 'fallback', sheetName: sess.sheetName, status: sess.status, notes: sess.notes, sourceUrl: sess.sourceUrl || null, linkTemplate: sess.linkTemplate || '' });%0A      state.isDirty = true; // still needs exporting%0A      updateSaveIndicator();%0A      scheduleSave(0);%0A    }%0A  } catch (e) {%0A    err('Restore failed', e);%0A    toast(`Restore failed: ${e.message}`, 'error');%0A  }%0A}%0A%0Aasync function renderRecents() {%0A  try {%0A    const all = (await idbGetAll('handles')).filter(r => r.name && r.ts).sort((a, b) => b.ts - a.ts).slice(0, 5);%0A    if (!all.length) return;%0A    els.recents.hidden = false;%0A    els.recentsList.innerHTML = '';%0A    for (const r of all) {%0A      const btn = document.createElement('button');%0A      btn.className = 'recent-item';%0A      btn.innerHTML = `<span>▤ ${esc(r.name)}</span><span class="ts">${new Date(r.ts).toLocaleString()}</span>`;%0A      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {%0A        log('Recent file clicked:', r.name);%0A        if (r.kind === 'fs' && r.handle) { restoreHandle(r.handle); }%0A        else if (r.kind === 'url' && r.url) { loadFromUrl(r.url); }%0A        else { restoreLastFile(); }%0A      });%0A      els.recentsList.appendChild(btn);%0A    }%0A    log(`Rendered ${all.length} recent file(s)`);%0A  } catch (e) { warn('Recents render failed', e); }%0A}%0A%0Aasync function restoreHandle(handle) {%0A  try {%0A    let perm = await handle.queryPermission({ mode: 'readwrite' });%0A    if (perm !== 'granted') perm = await handle.requestPermission({ mode: 'readwrite' });%0A    if (perm !== 'granted') { toast('Permission denied — pick the file again', 'error'); return; }%0A    await loadFromFileObject(await handle.getFile(), handle);%0A  } catch (e) {%0A    err('Recent-file restore failed', e);%0A    toast(`Could not reopen file: ${e.message}`, 'error');%0A  }%0A}%0A%0A/* ------------------------------- Rendering ------------------------------- */%0Afunction cardCount() { return state.data.length - (state.hasHeader ? 1 : 0); }%0A%0Afunction updateChrome() {%0A  const modeLabels = { fs: 'file write-back ON', fallback: SESSION_ONLY ? 'this tab only — export to keep' : 'fallback: browser storage', remote: 'remote file (read-only source)', demo: 'demo data' };%0A  const has = cardCount() > 0;%0A  // Sidebar header: file name + save state%0A  els.headName.innerHTML = state.name%0A    ? `${esc(state.name)} <span class="head-mode">· ${modeLabels[state.mode] || ''} · ${state.ext.toUpperCase()}${state.linkTemplate ? ' · portal links' : ''}</span>`%0A    : '<span class="no-file">No file loaded</span>';%0A  els.headName.title = state.sourceUrl ? `${state.name} — from ${state.sourceUrl}` : (state.name || '');%0A  // Menu item availability%0A  els.miClose.disabled = !state.mode;%0A  els.miLink.disabled = !state.sourceUrl && !state.mode;%0A  els.miExportCsv.disabled = !has;%0A  els.miExportXlsx.disabled = !has || !HAS_XLSX_WRITE;%0A  els.miExportXlsx.hidden = !HAS_XLSX_WRITE;   // no workbook writer → offer only what works%0A  updateSaveIndicator();%0A  renderModeMenu();%0A  renderAutoRows();%0A}%0A%0Afunction updateSaveIndicator() {%0A  const el = els.headSave;%0A  el.className = '';%0A  if (!state.mode) { el.textContent = ''; return; }%0A  if (state.isDirty) { el.className = 'dirty'; el.textContent = '● unsaved'; }%0A  else if (state.lastSavedAt) {%0A    el.className = 'saved';%0A    el.textContent = `✓ saved ${new Date(state.lastSavedAt).toLocaleTimeString()}`;%0A  } else el.textContent = '';%0A}%0A%0A/* ------------------------------ Card ordering ----------------------------- */%0Afunction buildSortOptions() {%0A  els.sortCol.innerHTML = '<option value="">File order</option>';%0A  const width = state.data.reduce((m, r) => Math.max(m, r.length), 0);%0A  const fixed = new Set([state.urlCol, state.nameCol, state.statusCol, state.notesCol].filter(c => c >= 0));%0A  for (let c = 0; c < width; c++) {%0A    const o = document.createElement('option');%0A    o.value = String(c);%0A    o.textContent = (fixed.has(c) ? colLabel(c) + ' *' : colLabel(c));%0A    els.sortCol.appendChild(o);%0A  }%0A  els.sortCol.value = state.sortCol === null ? '' : String(state.sortCol);%0A}%0A%0Afunction sortedIndices() {%0A  const total = cardCount();%0A  const idx = Array.from({ length: total }, (_, i) => i);%0A  if (state.sortCol === null || state.sortCol < 0) return idx;%0A  const c = state.sortCol;%0A  const val = i => String((state.data[i + (state.hasHeader ? 1 : 0)] || [])[c] ?? '').trim();%0A  const numeric = idx.every(i => val(i) === '' || /^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(val(i)));%0A  idx.sort((a, b) => {%0A    const va = val(a), vb = val(b);%0A    let cmp;%0A    if (numeric) cmp = (parseFloat(va) || 0) - (parseFloat(vb) || 0);%0A    else cmp = va.localeCompare(vb, undefined, { sensitivity: 'base', numeric: true });%0A    return state.sortAsc ? cmp : -cmp;%0A  });%0A  return idx;%0A}%0A%0A/** Next incomplete card in file order after row i (or first, when i is null). */%0Afunction nextIncompleteRow(afterRow) {%0A  const total = cardCount();%0A  const start = afterRow === null || afterRow === undefined ? 0 : afterRow + 1;%0A  for (let j = start; j < total; j++) if ((state.status[j] || 'incomplete') !== 'complete') return j;%0A  for (let j = 0; j <= (afterRow ?? -1); j++) if ((state.status[j] || 'incomplete') !== 'complete') return j; // wrap%0A  return -1;%0A}%0A%0A/* The one place that answers "where does row i go?". A cell whose value is a%0A   page, an address or a number answers for itself; a list with a portal template%0A   gets its URL composed from the row. Everything downstream — the card, the open%0A   modes, ?open=1 — reads this, so all of them agree by construction. */%0Afunction rowLink(i) {%0A  const row = state.data[i + (state.hasHeader ? 1 : 0)] || [];%0A  if (state.linkTemplate) {%0A    const composed = applyUrlTemplate(state.linkTemplate, row, state.data[0] || []);%0A    if (composed) return { href: composed, kind: 'url', value: composed, composed: true };%0A  }%0A  const raw = String(row[state.urlCol] ?? '').trim();%0A  const kind = linkKindOf(raw);%0A  return kind ? { href: linkHrefOf(raw), kind, value: raw, composed: false } : null;%0A}%0A%0A/** One editable cell's control. `i` is the card index — what statuses, notes and%0A    tabs are all keyed by — and `c` is the column.%0A%0A    Every control carries its own coordinates in `data-cell="i:c"` rather than leaning%0A    on where it sits in the DOM, because the sidebar is rebuilt from scratch on every%0A    tick, sort, search and edit, so a positional index would be a promise the markup%0A    cannot keep.%0A%0A    The row's own value is always an option in a dropdown or a button array, even when%0A    the choice list has moved on. A control that cannot display what the file says%0A    would be lying about the data it is showing, and silently dropping a value on the%0A    next write is the one thing an editable column must never do. */%0Afunction cellEditor(c, i, raw, type) {%0A  const key = `${i}:${c}`;%0A  const label = esc(colLabel(c));%0A  if (type === 'text')%0A    return `<input class="cell-input" type="text" data-cell="${key}" value="${esc(raw)}" placeholder="${label}" aria-label="${label}">`;%0A  if (type === 'long')%0A    return `<textarea class="cell-area" rows="2" data-cell="${key}" placeholder="${label}" aria-label="${label}">${esc(raw)}</textarea>`;%0A  const list = fieldOptions(c);%0A  const all = raw && !list.includes(raw) ? [raw, ...list] : list;%0A  if (type === 'select')%0A    return `<select class="cell-select" data-cell="${key}" aria-label="${label}">`%0A      + `<option value=""${raw ? '' : ' selected'}>—</option>`%0A      + all.map(v => `<option value="${esc(v)}"${v === raw ? ' selected' : ''}>${esc(v)}</option>`).join('')%0A      + `</select>`;%0A  return `<span class="cell-btns" role="group" aria-label="${label}">`%0A    + (raw ? '' : '<span class="emptyv">—</span>')%0A    + all.map(v => `<button class="cell-btn${v === raw ? ' on' : ''}" type="button" data-cell="${key}" data-cellvalue="${esc(v)}" aria-pressed="${v === raw ? 'true' : 'false'}">${esc(v)}</button>`).join('')%0A    + `</span>`;%0A}%0A%0A/** Write an edited cell back into the row it belongs to — and only there.%0A%0A    The matrix is the single source of truth for a loaded list, so an edit here is%0A    exported by exactly the path a status tick already takes: `buildExportMatrix()`%0A    copies `state.data` and overlays Status/Notes, and CSV, TSV and XLSX all write that%0A    out. No second store, no second save path — and search (`row.join(' ')`), the sort%0A    comparators and the copy buttons pick the new value up with no bookkeeping at all.%0A%0A    `live` is true while the user is typing: re-rendering the sidebar there would take%0A    the caret out of the field they are typing in. A dropdown or a button has no caret%0A    to lose, and re-rendering is how its own selected state gets redrawn. */%0Afunction writeCellValue(key, value, live = false) {%0A  const [i, c] = String(key).split(':').map(Number);%0A  if (!Number.isInteger(i) || !Number.isInteger(c)) { warn(`writeCellValue: bad cell key "${key}"`); return; }%0A  const r = i + (state.hasHeader ? 1 : 0);%0A  const row = state.data[r] || (state.data[r] = []);%0A  while (row.length <= c) row.push('');%0A  const before = String(row[c] ?? '');%0A  const after = String(value ?? '');%0A  if (before === after) return;%0A  row[c] = after;%0A  log(`Cell edited (row ${i}, ${colLabel(c)}): ${after ? `“${after.slice(0, 40)}”` : 'cleared'}`);%0A  markDirty();%0A  if (!live) renderCards();%0A}%0A%0Afunction renderCards() {%0A  const q = state.search.trim().toLowerCase();%0A  const total = cardCount();%0A  const cols = cardColumns();               // display-ordered, hidden-removed%0A  const collapsed = cols.slice(0, COLLAPSED_COLS);%0A  const extra = cols.slice(COLLAPSED_COLS); // shown only when expanded%0A  let visible = 0;%0A  log(`renderCards: total=${total}, cols=${cols.length}, sort=${state.sortCol === null ? 'file' : state.sortCol + (state.sortAsc ? ' asc' : ' desc')}, search="${q}", showCompleted=${!state.hideCompleted}`);%0A  const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();%0A%0A  const copyBtn = (value, label, key) =>%0A    `<button class="icon copy" data-copy-col="${key}" data-copy-label="${esc(label)}" title="Copy ${esc(label)}">⧉</button>`;%0A%0A  const colRow = (c, i) => {%0A    const row = state.data[i + (state.hasHeader ? 1 : 0)] || [];%0A    const raw = String(row[c] ?? '').trim();%0A    const type = state.colTypes[c] || '';%0A    /* An editable cell keeps its row even when it is empty — an empty field is the%0A       whole point of an editable column, and hiding it would make the column%0A       impossible to fill in. Every other empty cell still disappears. */%0A    if (!raw && !type) return ''; // no value → no row, no clutter%0A    /* The link column already has a home on the card, so don't repeat it here.%0A       Every *other* cell that is an address or a number becomes a real link, so%0A       MailLayer and PhoneLayer pick the click up wherever it appears — no need%0A       to flag those columns in Settings first. */%0A    const kind = (type || c === state.urlCol) ? null : linkKindOf(raw);%0A    const body = type ? cellEditor(c, i, raw, type)%0A      : kind%0A        ? `<a class="cell-link" href="${esc(linkHrefOf(raw))}"${kind === 'url' ? ' target="_blank" rel="noopener"' : layerAnchorAttrs(kind)}>${esc(raw)}</a>`%0A        : esc(raw);%0A    return `<div class="col-row">%0A      <span class="ck">${esc(colLabel(c))}</span>%0A      <span class="cv">${body}</span>%0A      ${copyBtn(raw, colLabel(c), `${i}:${c}`)}%0A    </div>`;%0A  };%0A%0A  for (const i of sortedIndices()) {%0A    const row = state.data[i + (state.hasHeader ? 1 : 0)] || [];%0A    const link = rowLink(i);%0A    const url = link ? link.value : '';%0A    /* Where the primary link goes depends on what the value *is*: a page opens in%0A       a real tab, an address goes to the MailLayer composer, a number to the%0A       PhoneLayer provider picker. */%0A    const urlKind = link ? link.kind : null;%0A    const urlHref = link ? link.href : '';%0A    const urlAttrs = (urlKind === 'url' ? ' target="_blank" rel="noopener"' : '') + layerAnchorAttrs(urlKind);%0A    const urlGlyph = urlKind === 'email' ? '✉' : urlKind === 'phone' ? '☎' : '↗';%0A    /* A composed link is labeled with the portal it came from when the template%0A       is the same for every row, and with the composed URL when the row's own%0A       values are what make it different. */%0A    const urlShown = link && link.composed && !templateFields(state.linkTemplate).length ? portalLabel(state.linkTemplate) : url;%0A    const urlHint = urlKind === 'email' ? `Compose an email to ${url}`%0A      : urlKind === 'phone' ? `Call or text ${url}`%0A      : link && link.composed ? `Open this row in ${portalLabel(state.linkTemplate)}`%0A      : urlKind === 'url' ? 'Open in new browser tab (always a real tab)'%0A      : 'Open this link';%0A    const name = String(state.nameCol >= 0 ? row[state.nameCol] : '') || url;%0A    const status = state.status[i] || 'incomplete';%0A    const notes = state.notes[i] || '';%0A%0A    if (state.hideCompleted && status === 'complete') continue;%0A    if (q && !(`${name} ${url} ${notes} ${row.join(' ')}`.toLowerCase().includes(q))) continue;%0A    visible++;%0A%0A    const expanded = !!state.expanded[i] || extra.length === 0;%0A    const shown = expanded ? cols : collapsed;%0A    const colRows = shown.map(c => colRow(c, i)).join('');%0A    const moreBtn = extra.length%0A      ? `<button class="col-more" data-toggle-col="${i}">${expanded ? '▲ Less' : `▼ +${extra.length} more column${extra.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`}</button>`%0A      : '';%0A%0A    const card = document.createElement('article');%0A    card.className = 'card' + (status === 'complete' ? ' done' : '') + (expanded ? ' ex' : '');%0A    card.dataset.rowIndex = i; // PRD: DOM↔array mapping via data-row-index%0A    card.innerHTML = `%0A      <div class="card-top">%0A        <button class="card-title" title="${state.autoOpenOnSelect ? 'Open this link (your chosen mode) + show all columns' : 'Show all columns — the link opens from its ↗, or turn on the automation in ☰'} ">${highlight(name, state.search.trim())}</button>%0A        ${copyBtn(name, 'name', `${i}:name`)}%0A        ${url ? `<a class="icon" href="${esc(urlHref)}"${urlAttrs} title="${esc(urlHint)}">${urlGlyph}</a>` : ''}%0A      </div>%0A      <div class="card-url">%0A        ${url ? `<a href="${esc(urlHref)}"${urlAttrs} title="${esc(urlHint)}">${highlight(urlShown, state.search.trim())}</a>` : ''}%0A        ${copyBtn(url, 'URL', `${i}:url`)}%0A      </div>%0A      ${colRows}%0A      ${moreBtn}%0A      <div class="card-mid">%0A        ${status === 'complete'%0A          ? `<button class="btn-undo" data-undo="${i}" title="Mark back to incomplete">↺ Incomplete</button>`%0A          : `<button class="btn-done" data-done="${i}" title="Mark complete (auto-opens next when enabled)">✓ Complete</button>`}%0A      </div>%0A      <div class="card-notes">%0A        <span class="label">Notes ${copyBtn(notes, 'notes', `${i}:notes`)}</span>%0A        <textarea rows="2" placeholder="Add a note…" data-notes="${i}">${esc(notes)}</textarea>%0A      </div>`;%0A    frag.appendChild(card);%0A  }%0A%0A  const done = state.status.filter(s => s === 'complete').length;%0A  const allDone = total > 0 && state.hideCompleted && done === total;%0A  els.cards.innerHTML = '';%0A  if (!visible) els.cards.innerHTML = `<div class="empty">${%0A    !total ? 'No file loaded yet.<br>Open a link list to populate task cards.'%0A    : allDone ? `All ${total} task${total === 1 ? '' : 's'} complete — tick “Show completed” to review them.`%0A    : 'No tasks match your filters.'}</div>`;%0A  else els.cards.appendChild(frag);%0A%0A  els.countTotal.textContent = `${total} task${total === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;%0A  els.countDone.textContent = `${done} done`;%0A  els.countLeft.textContent = `${total - done} left`;%0A  els.filterInfo.textContent = q || state.hideCompleted ? `${visible} shown · ${done} hidden` : '';%0A  log(`renderCards done: ${visible} visible, ${done} complete`);%0A}%0A%0A/** Completion side-effects: hide the done card (default) and auto-advance. */%0A/** The tab a completed row opened, closed with it.%0A%0A    Three things have to be true and each one is a decision, not a guard:%0A%0A    · the automation is on (it is on by default — a toggle nobody finds is a feature%0A      nobody has);%0A    · links open in **tabs**, because a real browser tab or a popup window is not ours%0A      to close; and%0A    · the tab belongs to the *row*. A portal-template list composes each row's address%0A      out of the one system the whole list keys into, so its tab is the portal the user%0A      is working *in*: closing it on every tick would pull them out of the place they%0A      are working. That is the "unless the whole list happens in one portal" case, and%0A      the switch says so instead of doing nothing when pressed. */%0Afunction closeTabForCompletedRow(i) {%0A  if (!state.autoCloseOnComplete) return null;%0A  if (getOpenMode() !== 'tabs') return null;%0A  if (autoCloseBlockedReason()) { log(`Auto-close skipped for row ${i}: ${autoCloseBlockedReason()}`); return null; }%0A  const t = tabs.find(x => x.rowId === i);%0A  if (!t) return null;%0A  log(`Auto-close: closing tab ${t.id} (${t.title}) with completed row ${i}`);%0A  closeTab(t.id);%0A  return t;%0A}%0A%0A/** Why this automation is not on offer, or null when it is.%0A%0A    One function, one line each, so a port with no iframes can say its own reason%0A    instead of inheriting the web app's — the panel edition opens real browser tabs,%0A    and a tab in the user's own window is theirs to close, not ours. */%0Afunction autoCloseBlockedReason() {%0A  if (state.linkTemplate) return 'Not for a portal list: every row works in the one shared portal, so closing its tab would pull you out of it.';%0A  return null;%0A}%0A%0Afunction afterComplete(i) {%0A  const closed = closeTabForCompletedRow(i);%0A  if (closed) toast(`Closed the tab for “${closed.title}”`);%0A  if (state.autoAdvance) {%0A    const next = nextIncompleteRow(i);%0A    if (next >= 0) {%0A      log(`Auto-advance: next incomplete row is ${next}`);%0A      state.expanded[next] = true;%0A      openUrlFor(next);%0A    } else {%0A      log('Auto-advance: no incomplete rows left — queue finished!');%0A      toast('Queue finished — every task is complete', 'success');%0A    }%0A  }%0A  renderCards();%0A  markDirty();%0A}%0A%0A/* ------------------------------ Open modes -------------------------------- */%0A/* How a card's link opens: tabbed iframes, a real browser tab, or a popup window.%0A   User-selectable at any time; remembered across sessions. */%0Aconst LS_OPEN_MODE = 'turnstone-open-mode';%0Aconst OPEN_MODES = {%0A  tabs:   { label: 'Tabs (iframes)',       hint: 'Open inside this app, one tab per link' },%0A  newtab: { label: 'New browser tab',      hint: 'Hand off to a full browser tab' },%0A  newwin: { label: 'New popup window',     hint: 'Small always-on-top window beside the queue' },%0A};%0A%0Afunction getOpenMode() {%0A  try { const m = localStorage.getItem(LS_OPEN_MODE); if (OPEN_MODES[m]) return m; } catch (e) {}%0A  return 'tabs';%0A}%0A%0Afunction setOpenMode(m, announce = true) {%0A  if (!OPEN_MODES[m]) return;%0A  try { localStorage.setItem(LS_OPEN_MODE, m); } catch (e) { warn('Could not persist open mode', e); }%0A  if (announce) { log(`Open mode → ${OPEN_MODES[m].label}`); toast(`Links now open as ${OPEN_MODES[m].label.toLowerCase()}`); }%0A  renderModeMenu();%0A}%0A%0A/** Open a task URL according to the current mode. */%0Afunction openUrlFor(i) {%0A  const link = rowLink(i);%0A  const url = link ? link.href : '';%0A  if (!url) { warn(`openUrlFor(${i}): no URL in row (and no portal template composed one)`); return; }%0A  const mode = getOpenMode();%0A  log(`Opening row ${i} as ${mode}: ${url}`);%0A  if (mode === 'tabs') { openInIframe(url, i); return; }%0A  if (mode === 'newtab') { window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener'); return; }%0A  if (mode === 'newwin') {%0A    const w = window.open(url, 'turnstone-win', 'popup=yes,width=1024,height=768,noopener');%0A    if (!w) toast('Popup blocked — allow popups for this site, or use Tabs/New tab mode', 'error');%0A  }%0A}%0A%0Afunction renderModeMenu() {%0A  const mode = getOpenMode();%0A  els.menu.querySelectorAll('.mode-item').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('checked', b.dataset.mode === mode));%0A  els.tabbar.classList.toggle('hidden-mode', mode !== 'tabs');%0A}%0A%0A/* ------------------------- Tabbed iframe workspace ------------------------ */%0Alet tabs = [];        // { id, url, title, rowId }%0Alet activeTabId = null;%0Alet tabSeq = 0;%0A%0A/** PRD Task 3.2: open (or focus) a URL in a tabbed iframe. */%0Afunction openInIframe(url, rowId) {%0A  if (!url) { warn('openInIframe called with empty URL'); return; }%0A  const existing = tabs.find(t => t.rowId === rowId && t.url === url);%0A  if (existing) { log(`Tab for row ${rowId} already open → focusing tab ${existing.id}`); activateTab(existing.id); return; }%0A%0A  const id = 'tab-' + (++tabSeq);%0A  const title = tabTitle(url, rowId);%0A  log(`Opening iframe tab ${id}: "${title}" → ${url}`);%0A  tabs.push({ id, url, title, rowId });%0A%0A  const pane = document.createElement('div');%0A  pane.className = 'pane'; pane.id = id; pane.dataset.tabId = id;%0A  pane.innerHTML = `<iframe src="${esc(url)}" referrerpolicy="no-referrer-when-downgrade" allow="fullscreen"></iframe>`;%0A  els.panes.appendChild(pane);%0A%0A  renderTabbar();%0A  activateTab(id);%0A}%0A%0Afunction tabTitle(url, rowId) {%0A  const row = state.data[rowId + (state.hasHeader ? 1 : 0)] || [];%0A  const name = String(state.nameCol >= 0 ? row[state.nameCol] : '').trim();%0A  let t = name || url.replace(/^https?:\/\//, '');%0A  if (t.length > 26) t = t.slice(0, 25) + '…';%0A  return t;%0A}%0A%0Afunction renderTabbar() {%0A  els.tabbar.innerHTML = '';%0A  for (const t of tabs) {%0A    const tab = document.createElement('div');%0A    tab.className = 'tab' + (t.id === activeTabId ? ' active' : '');%0A    tab.dataset.tabId = t.id;%0A    tab.title = t.url;%0A    tab.innerHTML = `%0A      <span class="tab-title">${esc(t.title)}</span>%0A      <a class="tab-ext" href="${esc(t.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="Open in new browser tab">↗</a>%0A      <button class="tab-close" title="Close tab">✕</button>`;%0A    els.tabbar.appendChild(tab);%0A  }%0A}%0A%0A/** PRD Task 3.3: switch tabs by hiding/showing panes (iframes never reload). */%0Afunction activateTab(id) {%0A  activeTabId = id;%0A  const target = tabs.find(t => t.id === id);%0A  log(`Activating tab ${id}${target ? ` (${target.title})` : ''}`);%0A  for (const pane of els.panes.querySelectorAll('.pane')) pane.classList.toggle('active', pane.id === id);%0A  renderTabbar();%0A}%0A%0Afunction closeTab(id) {%0A  const idx = tabs.findIndex(t => t.id === id);%0A  if (idx < 0) return;%0A  log(`Closing tab ${id} (${tabs[idx].title})`);%0A  els.panes.querySelector(`%23${CSS.escape(id)}`)?.remove(); // destroys the iframe%0A  tabs.splice(idx, 1);%0A  if (activeTabId === id) {%0A    const next = tabs[Math.min(idx, tabs.length - 1)];%0A    activeTabId = next ? next.id : null;%0A  }%0A  renderTabbar();%0A  if (activeTabId) activateTab(activeTabId);%0A}%0A%0Afunction closeAllTabs() {%0A  if (tabs.length) log(`Closing all ${tabs.length} tab(s) for new file`);%0A  tabs = []; activeTabId = null;%0A  els.tabbar.innerHTML = '';%0A  els.panes.querySelectorAll('.pane').forEach(p => p.remove());%0A}%0A%0A/* ------------------------ Write-back & persistence ----------------------- */%0Alet saveTimer = null;%0A%0A/** PRD Task 4.1: debounced auto-save (1.2s in FS mode, 0.7s fallback). */%0Afunction markDirty() {%0A  state.isDirty = true;%0A  updateSaveIndicator();%0A  scheduleSave();%0A}%0Afunction scheduleSave(delay) {%0A  clearTimeout(saveTimer);%0A  const d = delay ?? (state.mode === 'fs' ? 1200 : 700);%0A  saveTimer = setTimeout(saveNow, d);%0A}%0A%0Aasync function saveNow() {%0A  if (!state.mode || !cardCount()) return;%0A  clearTimeout(saveTimer);%0A  const t0 = performance.now();%0A  log(`saveNow: mode=${state.mode}, dirty=${state.isDirty}`);%0A  try {%0A    if (state.mode === 'fs' && state.fileHandle && canWrite(state.ext)) {%0A      const perm = await state.fileHandle.queryPermission({ mode: 'readwrite' });%0A      if (perm !== 'granted') {%0A        warn('Write permission lost — cannot silently save. Data kept in memory.');%0A        toast('File permission expired — use Restore Workspace to re-authorize, then edit again.', 'error');%0A        await persistSessionSnapshot(); // safety net%0A        return;%0A      }%0A      await writeBackToFile();%0A      state.isDirty = false;%0A      state.lastSavedAt = Date.now(); state.lastSavedWhere = 'to file';%0A      log(`Wrote file "${state.name}" in ${(performance.now() - t0).toFixed(0)}ms`);%0A    } else {%0A      const snapshotted = await persistSessionSnapshot();%0A      /* Saved is saved — including in fallback mode, where "saved" means the%0A         snapshot in browser storage. This used to stay dirty on purpose, to keep%0A         nudging the user to export. It made the status line say "● unsaved" about%0A         work that had just been written, and — worse — it armed the beforeunload%0A         guard permanently, so **every reload and every tab close** raised a%0A         "you have unexported changes" confirm over a list that was already saved.%0A         A prompt that always fires is one people learn to click through, which is%0A         how the guard stops protecting the one case it exists for. The header still%0A         says "fallback: browser storage", and the import toast still says so. */%0A      /* …and if the snapshot did not land, nothing is saved: stay dirty, so the%0A         status line and the unload guard both keep telling the truth. A build with%0A         no durable storage at all (the bookmarklet's throwaway origin) therefore%0A         keeps its guard armed, which is exactly right there. */%0A      state.isDirty = !snapshotted;%0A      if (!snapshotted) warn('Snapshot did not persist — this build has nowhere durable to put it; export to keep the work');%0A      state.lastSavedAt = Date.now(); state.lastSavedWhere = 'to browser storage';%0A      log(`Saved session snapshot in ${(performance.now() - t0).toFixed(0)}ms`);%0A    }%0A  } catch (e) {%0A    err('Save failed', e);%0A    toast(`Save failed: ${e.message}`, 'error');%0A  }%0A  updateSaveIndicator();%0A}%0A%0A/** Merge virtual Status/Notes columns into an export matrix. */%0Afunction buildExportMatrix() {%0A  let next = state.data.reduce((m, r) => Math.max(m, r.length), 1);%0A  const stCol = state.statusCol >= 0 ? state.statusCol : next++;%0A  const ntCol = state.notesCol >= 0 ? state.notesCol : next++;%0A%0A  const out = [];%0A  if (state.hasHeader) {%0A    const header = state.data[0].slice();%0A    while (header.length < next) header.push('');%0A    header[stCol] = 'Status';%0A    header[ntCol] = 'Notes';%0A    out.push(header);%0A  } else {%0A    out.push(Array.from({ length: next }, (_, c) => c === state.urlCol ? 'URL' : c === stCol ? 'Status' : c === ntCol ? 'Notes' : `Column ${c + 1}`));%0A    log('No header row in source — a header row will be added on write-back to persist Status/Notes');%0A  }%0A  for (let i = 0; i < cardCount(); i++) {%0A    const row = (state.data[i + (state.hasHeader ? 1 : 0)] || []).slice();%0A    while (row.length < next) row.push('');%0A    row[stCol] = state.status[i] || 'incomplete';%0A    row[ntCol] = state.notes[i] || '';%0A    out.push(row);%0A  }%0A  log(`buildExportMatrix: ${out.length} rows × ${next} cols (status@${stCol}, notes@${ntCol})`);%0A  return out;%0A}%0A%0A/** PRD Task 4.1: silent write-back via File System Access API. */%0Aasync function writeBackToFile() {%0A  const matrix = buildExportMatrix();%0A  const writable = await state.fileHandle.createWritable();%0A  try {%0A    if (isWorkbookFormat(state.ext)) {%0A      const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();%0A      XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(matrix), sanitizeSheetName(state.sheetName));%0A      await writable.write(XLSX.write(wb, { type: 'array', bookType: 'xlsx' }));%0A    } else {%0A      // Delimited text keeps its own delimiter so a TSV source stays a TSV.%0A      await writable.write(Papa.unparse(matrix, { delimiter: state.ext === 'tsv' ? '\t' : ',' }));%0A    }%0A  } finally {%0A    await writable.close();%0A  }%0A  log(`Write-back complete (${state.ext})`);%0A}%0A%0Afunction sanitizeSheetName(n) {%0A  const clean = String(n || 'Sheet1').replace(/[\\/?*[\]:]/g, '_');%0A  return clean.slice(0, 31) || 'Sheet1';%0A}%0A%0A/** PRD Task 4.3: fallback persistence — full snapshot to IndexedDB. */%0Aasync function persistSessionSnapshot() {%0A  try {%0A    await idbPut('session', {%0A      key: 'session', name: state.name, ext: state.ext, sheetName: state.sheetName,%0A      data: state.data, status: state.status, notes: state.notes, sourceUrl: state.sourceUrl,%0A      linkTemplate: state.linkTemplate,   // a headerless portal list has no signature to remember it against%0A      ts: Date.now(),%0A    });%0A    log(`Session snapshot persisted (${cardCount()} cards)`);%0A    return true;%0A  } catch (e) {%0A    err('Session snapshot failed (file too large for IndexedDB?)', e);%0A    return false;   // the caller must not report "saved" for a snapshot that did not land%0A  }%0A}%0A%0A/* PRD Task 4.3: export via Blob download (always available). */%0Afunction exportFile(kind) {%0A  if (kind === 'xlsx' && !HAS_XLSX_WRITE) {%0A    warn('XLSX export requested in a build without a workbook writer');%0A    toast('XLSX export is not in this build — Export CSV instead', 'error');%0A    return;%0A  }%0A  const matrix = buildExportMatrix();%0A  const base = (state.name || 'turnstone').replace(/\.[a-z0-9]+$/i, '');%0A  const a = document.createElement('a');%0A  if (kind === 'xlsx') {%0A    const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();%0A    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(matrix), sanitizeSheetName(state.sheetName));%0A    const buf = XLSX.write(wb, { type: 'array', bookType: 'xlsx' });%0A    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([buf], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' }));%0A    a.download = base + '.xlsx';%0A  } else {%0A    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([Papa.unparse(matrix)], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' }));%0A    a.download = base + '-turnstone.csv';%0A  }%0A  document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();%0A  log(`Exported ${a.download} (${kind})`);%0A  toast(`Exported ${a.download}`, 'success');%0A}%0A%0A/* beforeunload guard removed in the bookmarklet build: leaving a page is the host%0A   page's business, and our state is session-only by design anyway. */%0A// Safety net: flush pending debounced saves when the tab is hidden.%0Adocument.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {%0A  if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden' && state.isDirty) { log('Visibility hidden → flushing pending save'); saveNow(); }%0A});%0A%0A/* PWA plumbing removed in the bookmarklet build — an installed app and an%0A   install prompt belong to a real origin, not to a page we were launched from. */%0A%0A/* Service worker: offline shell. Skipped on plain file:// (nothing to serve), and%0A   skipped in the standalone single-file build, where there is no sw.js to load.%0A   assets/build-standalone.js flips STANDALONE_BUILD to true. */%0Aconst STANDALONE_BUILD = true;%0Aif (!STANDALONE_BUILD && (location.protocol === 'https:' || location.hostname === 'localhost' || location.hostname === '127.0.0.1')) {%0A  if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {%0A    navigator.serviceWorker.register('sw.js')%0A      .then((reg) => log(`Service worker registered (scope: ${reg.scope})`))%0A      .catch((e) => warn('Service worker registration failed (offline mode unavailable)', e));%0A  }%0A} else {%0A  log(STANDALONE_BUILD ? 'Service worker skipped (standalone single-file build)' : `Service worker skipped on ${location.protocol} origin`);%0A}%0A%0A/* Install button: only shown when the browser fires beforeinstallprompt. */%0Alet deferredInstallPrompt = null;%0Awindow.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', (e) => {%0A  e.preventDefault();%0A  deferredInstallPrompt = e;%0A  els.miInstall.hidden = false;%0A  log('Turnstone is installable → Install item shown in menu');%0A});%0Aels.miInstall.addEventListener('click', async () => {%0A  closeMenu();%0A  if (!deferredInstallPrompt) return;%0A  deferredInstallPrompt.prompt();%0A  const { outcome } = await deferredInstallPrompt.userChoice;%0A  log(`Install prompt outcome: ${outcome}`);%0A  deferredInstallPrompt = null;%0A  els.miInstall.hidden = true;%0A});%0Awindow.addEventListener('appinstalled', () => {%0A  els.miInstall.hidden = true;%0A  log('Turnstone installed as an app');%0A  toast('Turnstone installed — find it in your apps menu', 'success');%0A});%0A%0A/* ----------------------------- Demo dataset ------------------------------ */%0Aconst DEMO_CSV = `Name,URL,Notes%0AExample Domain,https://example.com/,%0AHTTPBin HTML,https://httpbin.org/html/,%0AMDN Web Docs,https://developer.mozilla.org/,%0AOpenStreetMap Embed,https://www.openstreetmap.org/export/embed.html?bbox=-0.2%252C51.4%252C0.0%252C51.6&layer=mapnik,%0AWikipedia,https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Main_Page,`;%0A%0Afunction loadDemo() {%0A  log('Loading demo dataset');%0A  const matrix = parseDelimitedText(DEMO_CSV, 'csv');%0A  loadMatrix(matrix, { name: 'demo-links.csv', ext: 'csv', mode: 'demo', sourceUrl: null });%0A  scheduleSave(0);%0A}%0A%0A/* ------------------------------ Event wiring ----------------------------- */%0A/* The ☰ menu — a panel over the whole app rather than a dropdown (see the CSS note).%0A   Everything the menu renders is re-rendered on open, so it can never show a stale%0A   ✓ or a switch in the wrong position: the file name, the open mode, and the three%0A   automations are all read at that moment. */%0Afunction openMenu() {%0A  els.menuFile.textContent = els.headName.textContent.trim();%0A  renderModeMenu();%0A  renderAutoRows();%0A  els.menu.hidden = false;%0A  els.menuClose.focus();%0A  log('Menu opened');%0A}%0Afunction closeMenu() {%0A  if (els.menu.hidden) return;%0A  els.menu.hidden = true;%0A  /* Back to the ☰ button — the menu's only opener, and therefore always the right place%0A     to land. It is also the honest answer: remembering `document.activeElement` looks%0A     tidier and fails on the one path that matters, because a programmatic click on a%0A     button does not focus it, so the "return target" would be the document body. */%0A  els.btnMenu.focus();%0A  log('Menu closed');%0A}%0Aels.btnMenu.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); els.menu.hidden ? openMenu() : closeMenu(); });%0Aels.menuClose.addEventListener('click', closeMenu);%0A/* A click that lands on the dimmed backdrop is a click outside; a click inside the panel%0A   is not, which is why this compares the target rather than asking for `closest`. */%0Aels.menu.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (e.target === els.menu) closeMenu(); });%0Adocument.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeMenu(); });%0A%0Aels.miOpen.addEventListener('click', () => { closeMenu(); openLocalFile(); });%0A%0A/* Drop zone: click/press to pick a file. A file we%0A   fetched can be pointed at (`?file=`), which is the smaller link. Anything else —%0A   a local pick, a dropped file, a paste, a database hand-off — has no address, so%0A   the list itself goes in the fragment (`%23zdata=`), carrying the statuses and notes%0A   entered so far. Both open the same workspace; the second one needs no server at all. */%0Aels.miOpenLink.addEventListener('click', () => { closeMenu(); showOpenLink(); });%0Aels.miBuild.addEventListener('click', () => { closeMenu(); showBuildLink(); });%0Aels.miLink.addEventListener('click', async () => {%0A  closeMenu();%0A  if (state.sourceUrl) {%0A    const link = `'https://spuds0588.github.io/Turnstone/app.html'?file=${encodeURIComponent(state.sourceUrl)}`;%0A    await copyText(link, 'shareable ?file= link');%0A    toast('Link copied — anyone opening it gets this same file', 'success');%0A    return;%0A  }%0A  if (!state.mode) return;%0A  try {%0A    const matrix = buildExportMatrix();%0A    const text = Papa.unparse(matrix, { delimiter: state.ext === 'tsv' ? '\t' : ',' });%0A    const params = {};%0A    if (state.linkTemplate) params.link = state.linkTemplate;%0A    const built = await buildInlineLink(text, { params });%0A    await copyText(built.url, 'workspace link');%0A    log(`Workspace link copied (${built.encoding}, ${built.bytes} bytes of list)`);%0A    toast(built.warning || 'Link copied — it carries the list, your notes and your ticks', built.warning ? 'warn' : 'success');%0A  } catch (e) {%0A    err('Could not build a workspace link', e);%0A    toast(`Could not build a link: ${e.message}`, 'error');%0A  }%0A});%0Aels.menu.querySelectorAll('.mode-item').forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', () => { closeMenu(); setOpenMode(b.dataset.mode); }));%0Aels.menu.querySelector('%23mi-mode-help')?.addEventListener('click', () => { closeMenu(); showModePicker(false); });%0A%0A/* ------------------------------ Automations ------------------------------- */%0A/* Three switches, persisted, and each announces what it just did — the row behind the%0A   panel is dimmed, so the toast is the only feedback that lands where the user is%0A   looking. `auto-close` defaults to ON, unlike the other two: it is the behaviour a%0A   queue wants (the tab belongs to the task that is now done), and a feature behind a%0A   switch nobody opens is a feature that does not exist. */%0Aconst LS_AUTO_OPEN = 'turnstone-auto-open', LS_AUTO_ADV = 'turnstone-auto-advance', LS_AUTO_CLOSE = 'turnstone-auto-close';%0A/* Two of the three are on by default, and that is deliberate rather than generous:%0A   "on" is what the app already did, so a default of "on" preserves every existing%0A   queue while giving the switch a real OFF — which is the only direction a switch can%0A   add a behaviour to something that already happens. */%0Afunction getAutoOpen() { try { return localStorage.getItem(LS_AUTO_OPEN) !== '0'; } catch (e) { return true; } }%0Afunction getAutoAdvance() { try { return localStorage.getItem(LS_AUTO_ADV) === '1'; } catch (e) { return false; } }%0Afunction getAutoClose() { try { return localStorage.getItem(LS_AUTO_CLOSE) !== '0'; } catch (e) { return true; } }%0A%0Afunction setAutoSwitch(row, on) { row.setAttribute('aria-checked', on ? 'true' : 'false'); }%0A%0A/* Read once, at load — and this is a bug fix, not a formality. The switches were always%0A   drawn from storage while the *behaviour* kept its in-memory default, so a reload showed%0A   "on" over an automation that was off until you toggled it twice. Both existing switches%0A   had it; the new one would have inherited it. */%0Afunction applyStoredAutomations() {%0A  state.autoOpenOnSelect = getAutoOpen();%0A  state.autoAdvance = getAutoAdvance();%0A  state.autoCloseOnComplete = getAutoClose();%0A  log(`Automations from storage: auto-open=${state.autoOpenOnSelect}, auto-advance=${state.autoAdvance}, auto-close=${state.autoCloseOnComplete}`);%0A}%0AapplyStoredAutomations();%0A%0A/* Re-rendered whenever the menu opens and whenever a list finishes loading, because one%0A   of the three is *not offered* for some lists: a portal list's tab is the portal the%0A   user is working in, so closing it on every tick would pull them out of it. Saying so%0A   is better than a switch that silently does nothing. */%0Afunction renderAutoRows() {%0A  const reason = autoCloseBlockedReason();%0A  setAutoSwitch(els.miAutoClose, getAutoClose());%0A  setAutoSwitch(els.miAutoOpen, getAutoOpen());%0A  setAutoSwitch(els.miAutoAdvance, getAutoAdvance());%0A  els.miAutoClose.disabled = !!reason;%0A  els.miAutoClose.title = reason || '';%0A  const hint = els.miAutoClose.querySelector('.auto-hint');%0A  hint.classList.toggle('warn', !!reason);%0A  hint.textContent = reason || 'Tabs mode: the tab this row opened closes with it.';%0A}%0A%0Aels.miAutoClose.addEventListener('click', () => {%0A  const next = !getAutoClose();%0A  try { localStorage.setItem(LS_AUTO_CLOSE, next ? '1' : '0'); } catch (e) {}%0A  state.autoCloseOnComplete = next;%0A  log(`Auto-close-on-complete → ${next}`);%0A  toast(next ? 'Completing a task now closes the tab it opened' : 'Tabs stay open when a task is complete');%0A  renderAutoRows();%0A});%0Aels.miAutoOpen.addEventListener('click', () => {%0A  const next = !getAutoOpen();%0A  try { localStorage.setItem(LS_AUTO_OPEN, next ? '1' : '0'); } catch (e) {}%0A  state.autoOpenOnSelect = next;%0A  log(`Auto-open-on-select → ${next}`);%0A  toast(next ? A phone or tablet (a coarse, non-hovering primary pointer) gets an%0A   honest, dismissible notice instead of a silently broken app. Touch laptops%0A   keep a fine primary pointer and pass; the extension's side panel is a desktop%0A   window and passes; a merely narrow desktop window passes too, since the%0A   layout is designed to work narrow. */%0Aconst MOBILE_POINTER_QUERY = '(pointer: coarse) and (hover: none)';%0Alet gateDismissed = false;%0Aconst isMobileLike = () => !!(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia(MOBILE_POINTER_QUERY).matches);%0A%0Afunction syncMobileGate() {%0A  const show = isMobileLike() && !gateDismissed;%0A  if (els.gate.hidden === !show) return;   // nothing changed → leave the DOM alone%0A  els.gate.hidden = !show;%0A  if (show) {%0A    els.gateW.textContent = window.innerWidth;%0A    els.gateH.textContent = window.innerHeight;%0A    log(`Touch-first pointer detected (${MOBILE_POINTER_QUERY}) at ${window.innerWidth}×${window.innerHeight} — showing the desktop-only notice`);%0A  } else log('Desktop-only notice hidden');%0A}%0A%0Aels.gateDismiss.addEventListener('click', () => {%0A  gateDismissed = true;%0A  log('Desktop-only notice dismissed by the user — continuing at their own risk');%0A  syncMobileGate();%0A});%0Aif (window.matchMedia) {%0A  const mq = matchMedia(MOBILE_POINTER_QUERY);%0A  if (mq.addEventListener) mq.addEventListener('change', syncMobileGate);%0A  else if (mq.addListener) mq.addListener(syncMobileGate);%0A}%0Awindow.addEventListener('resize', syncMobileGate);%0Awindow.addEventListener('orientationchange', syncMobileGate);%0AsyncMobileGate();%0A%0A/* --------------------------------- Boot ---------------------------------- */%0A(async function init() {%0A  log(`Turnstone initializing — FSA API: ${!!window.showOpenFilePicker}, XLSX: ${HAS_XLSX}, ZIP: ${HAS_INFLATE}, DOM: ${HAS_DOMPARSER}, layers: ${HAS_LAYERS}${HAS_LAYERS ? A fragment value wins on conflict. */%0A  const params = new Map();   // bookmarklet: the host page's URL is not ours to read%0A  const param = (k) => params.get(k) || '';%0A  const fileParam = param('file') || param('url');%0A  const openFirst = param('open') === '1';%0A  /* `?link=` names the portal a link-free list is worked in, so a portal queue can%0A     be shared as one URL: `?file=queue.csv&link=https://portal/ticket/{Ticket ID}`.%0A     It is applied when the file loads, and remembered for that header afterwards. */%0A  bootLinkTemplate = param('link').trim();%0A  if (bootLinkTemplate) log(`link template in the URL → portal template: ${bootLinkTemplate}`);%0A%0A  /* A workspace link: the list is *in* the URL, so there is nothing to fetch. This is also where the locked-scope "carry a queue across%0A * sessions" pair lives: storage is session-only by design (see boot-pre), so%0A * Copy state / Restore state is the supported way to move a queue between tabs.%0A * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */%0A%0A(function tsWireBar() {%0A  var bar = TS_SHADOW.getElementById('ts-bar');%0A  var label = TS_BMK.variant + (TS_BMK.libs.length ? ' · ' + TS_BMK.libs.join(' + ') : ' · no libraries');%0A  bar.querySelector('.ts-variant').textContent = label;%0A%0A  log(`Turnstone bookmarklet mounted — variant "${TS_BMK.variant}", libs [${TS_BMK.libs.join(', ') || 'none'}], ` +%0A      `styles ${TS_CSS_HOW}, XLSX read=${HAS_XLSX} write=${HAS_XLSX_WRITE}, IndexedDB=memory-only`);%0A%0A  /* --- Close: the overlay is the only thing we added to the page ---------- */%0A  TS_SHADOW.getElementById('ts-close').addEventListener('click', function () {%0A    log('Closing overlay — removing the host element');%0A    TS_HOST.remove();%0A    toast('Turnstone closed');%0A  });%0A%0A  /* --- Copy state: a self-contained JSON snapshot of the queue ------------ */%0A  function snapshot() {%0A    return {%0A      turnstone: 'bookmarklet-state/1',%0A      name: state.name,%0A      ext: state.ext,%0A      sheetName: state.sheetName,%0A      data: state.data,%0A      status: state.status,%0A      notes: state.notes,%0A      savedAt: new Date().toISOString(),%0A    };%0A  }%0A%0A  TS_SHADOW.getElementById('ts-copy').addEventListener('click', async function () {%0A    if (!cardCount()) { toast('Nothing to copy — load a list first', 'error'); return; }%0A    var json = JSON.stringify(snapshot());%0A    await copyText(json, 'queue state');%0A    log(`Copied queue state (${json.length} chars, ${cardCount()} cards)`);%0A    toast(`Copied ${cardCount()} card${cardCount() === 1 ? '' : 's'} as JSON (${(json.length / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB)`);%0A  });%0A%0A  /* --- Restore state: paste it back, statuses and notes included ---------- */%0A  function openRestorePanel() {%0A    var existing = TS_SHADOW.getElementById('ts-restore-panel');%0A    if (existing) { existing.remove(); return; }%0A    var panel = document.createElement('div');%0A    panel.id = 'ts-restore-panel';%0A    panel.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;top:34px;right:8px;z-index:5;width:min(560px,92vw);' +%0A      'background:var(--panel);color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;' +%0A      'padding:12px;box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.45)';%0A    panel.innerHTML =%0A      '<div style="font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px">Restore a copied queue</div>' +%0A      '<div style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:8px">Paste a state JSON from <em>Copy state</em>. ' +%0A      'Statuses and notes come back with it.</div>' +%0A      '<textarea id="ts-restore-text" spellcheck="false" placeholder=\'{"turnstone":"bookmarklet-state/1", …}\' ' +%0A      'style="width:100%25;height:110px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--border);' +%0A      'border-radius:6px;padding:7px;font:11.5px/1.4 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace"></textarea>' +%0A      '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:8px;justify-content:flex-end">' +%0A      '<button type="button" class="btn" id="ts-restore-cancel">Cancel</button>' +%0A      '<button type="button" class="btn" id="ts-restore-apply">Restore</button>' +%0A      '</div>';%0A    TS_SHADOW.appendChild(panel);%0A    var text = panel.querySelector('%23ts-restore-text');%0A    text.focus();%0A    panel.querySelector('%23ts-restore-cancel').addEventListener('click', function () { panel.remove(); });%0A    panel.querySelector('%23ts-restore-apply').addEventListener('click', function () {%0A      var raw = text.value.trim();%0A      if (!raw) { toast('Paste a copied state first', 'error'); return; }%0A      var parsed;%0A      try { parsed = JSON.parse(raw); }%0A      catch (e) { toast(`That is not valid JSON: ${e.message}`, 'error'); return; }%0A      if (!Array.isArray(parsed.data) || !parsed.data.length) { toast('That JSON has no queue data', 'error'); return; }%0A      var rows = parsed.data.length - (analyzeMatrix(parsed.data).hasHeader ? 1 : 0);%0A      if (Array.isArray(parsed.status) && parsed.status.length !== rows) {%0A        warn(`State status length ${parsed.status.length} ≠ ${rows} rows — statuses will be ignored`);%0A        parsed.status = null; parsed.notes = null;%0A      }%0A      log(`Restoring queue state: ${parsed.data.length} rows from "${parsed.name || 'pasted state'}"`);%0A      loadMatrix(parsed.data, {%0A        name: parsed.name || 'restored-state.csv',%0A        ext: parsed.ext || 'csv',%0A        mode: 'fallback',%0A        sheetName: parsed.sheetName,%0A        status: parsed.status,%0A        notes: parsed.notes,%0A      });%0A      panel.remove();%0A    });%0A  }%0A  TS_SHADOW.getElementById('ts-restore').addEventListener('click', openRestorePanel);%0A%0A  /* --- First-run hint + capability notice --------------------------------- */%0A  if (!HAS_XLSX) {%0A    toast('Turnstone (no libraries) is running — CSV, TSV, JSON, HTML and XML lists only', 'success');%0A  } else if (!HAS_XLSX_WRITE) {%0A    toast('Turnstone is running — workbooks open read-only, edits export as CSV', 'success');%0A  } else {%0A    toast('Turnstone is running in this page — drop a CSV/XLSX list anywhere', 'success');%0A  }%0A})();%0A%0A}).call(this);%0A})();void 0%0A
